PCA.TITLE: Police Controller Adapter
PCA.PARAGRAPH: An Innovative Proposal for the Control of Tachographs of Cargo Vehicles.
PCA.PARAGRAPH_1: Our Police Controller Adapter PCA-3.1A solution is an innovative offering for monitoring the speed of cargo trucks. It is designed to streamline and enhance the operations of mobile police speed-enforcement units using DSRC radar technology, delivering a solution that maximizes technical quality without compromising ease of use. Its primary function is to capture data from DSRC devices, link it to GPS (Global Positioning System) coordinates, and transmit it in real time to a police control point via LTE (Long Term Evolution) connectivity. Engineered to deliver consistent performance, reliability, and ease of use, it features a compact base platform that efficiently integrates all components. It is powered by a state-of-the-art minicomputer capable of real-time data processing and secure transmission. Equipped with a GPS and LTE-M communication module, the unit can transmit information and reports directly to various police control points, while the DSRC transceiver ensures accurate, rapid reading of tolling or contactless identification devices.

FEATURES.TEXT_1:
• Quick and secure mounting system: its suction cups allow it to be attached directly to the vehicle's glass, whether on the windshield, side windows, or rear window. Its articulated ball joint allows precise adjustment of its orientation, facilitating adaptation to the control point.
  • Design and protection: the controller is integrated into a reinforced housing, designed to offer greater protection against impacts and conditions typical of operational use, improving its resistance and durability.
FEATURES.TEXT_2:
• Greater discretion in operation: by being able to be installed inside the police vehicle, the system allows inspections to be carried out more discreetly, without the need for an external installation.
  • Motorcycle installation: it incorporates a configuration to be used also on motorcycles, expanding the possibilities of operational deployment.
  • Configuration for static controls: it can be installed on a tripod, allowing static controls to be carried out and adjusted according to the characteristics of the control point.
  • Size: with a portable design (30cm x 25cm x 12cm) that allows ease of transport and handling.
FEATURES.TEXT_3:
• The Police Controller Adapter exceeds the detection range from 15 to 20 meters. The solution includes a powerful Q-Free RSE651 antenna, which allows greater efficiency and data capture, such as reading more than two vehicles at a time, significantly increasing its performance.
  • It interprets and records the information contained in the tachograph in a practical way, allowing its integration between the antenna, the Police Controller and other applications that may be required.
  • Simple communications: The Wifi integrated in the adapter simplifies the configuration and data management, without the need to enter connection parameters that require additional technical knowledge.
FEATURES.TEXT_4:
The power supply system has been simplified, reducing the connections to one cable for the power input and another for the antenna:

  • For the input, the equipment can be powered through a 220 V AC or 12 V DC power outlet, adapting to the different options available in police vehicles (cigarette lighter or auxiliary socket).
  • For the output, it has a PoE cable of up to 10 meters that allows supplying power to the antenna while receiving and transmitting data.

PCA.PARAGRAPH_2:
PCA features software for the real-time monitoring of PCA devices, offering an intuitive, practical platform accessible via any web browser; from the main dashboard, you can view the exact location and operational status of each unit on a map.

It also enables the quick location of active devices through a simple list; selecting a device by name or IP address displays detailed information for more efficient management. In short: a tool designed to provide total control, immediate accessibility, and a clear overview of the system—all from a single location.
